jQuery is part of 7 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2025.

What it was for: [Web](@/projects/web.md) (4) and [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (3).

Most recently: [apollo-crawler-extension](@/work/apollo-crawler-extension.md): Apollo Platform Chrome Extension; [korczis-com](@/work/korczis-com.md): korczis.com website; [microcrawler-browser](@/work/microcrawler-browser.md): Proof-of-Concept: Microcrawler in your Browser!.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses jQuery: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links jQuery to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
